models.name: BM25+CatBoost
models.comment: The same Switch with a CatBoost ranker behind each branch: BM25 candidates for known users, most-popular candidates reranked on segment popularity for cold ones

models.name: BM25+XGBoost
models.comment: The BM25+CatBoost switch with XGBoost rank:ndcg rankers, regularized: at the defaults (300 trees, learning rate 0.1) it overfits the ranker's few hundred groups

models.name: BM25+LightGBM
models.comment: The BM25+CatBoost switch with LightGBM lambdarank rankers, regularized for the same reason as XGBoost

models.name: BM25+Blend
models.comment: BlendRanker at its defaults (logistic stacking on out-of-fold, rank-normalized scores) over the three boosters of the rows above

models.name: EASE
models.comment: Switch(KnownUser(), EASE(), MostPopularRecommender()): the other member of the fusions, on its own

models.name: BM25+EASE RRF
models.comment: ReciprocalRankFusion of BM25 and EASE for known users, most popular for the rest: no ranker, nothing learned

models.name: BM25+RRF
models.comment: The CatBoost switch with a training-free ReciprocalRankRanker: BM25 and EASE scores for known users, popularity and segment popularity for cold ones

models.name: BM25+RRF boosters
models.comment: ReciprocalRankRanker over the three boosters of the Blend row: their ranks fused, with no out-of-fold refits or blender
